'''Ravens''' were large [[Color/Legends|black]]-feathered [[Bird/Legends|birds]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They had a deep voice, larges beaks and pointed wings. Though [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], ravens had high bird intelligence and were perhaps amongst the smartest birds. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]] was known for [[Metamorphosis|turning into]] a raven thanks to her [[Talisman of the Raven|magic ring]], and she ended up stuck into this form when the talisman was destroyed.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Cawing_Charal.png|thumb|left|250px|The Nightsister Charal in raven form]]
Ravens were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|nonsentient]], large-sized [[Bird/Legends|birds]]<ref name="TBFE" /> native to the misty [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="BoSSotDS" /> an obscure [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Ravens had an all-[[Color/Legends|black]] plumage with shaggy feathers around the throat, pointed wings and a wedge-shaped tail. Their beak was large, slightly curved downward and heavy. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were slightly slanted, with dark brown irises. They had two short legs with strong three-clawed toes and a hook-like hind talon.<ref name="TBFE" /> Like all avians, they were warm-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] creatures.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

Ravens emitted different kinds of sounds varying from a low croak to shrill alarm cries. Depending on the emotional state, those often deep and reverberating calls were known as squawkings or shriekings.<ref name="TBFE" /><ref name="RW&C">''[[The Ring, the Witch, and the Crystal: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> A raven's thin tongue would raise when the bird was croaking.<ref name="TBFE" />

==History==
[[File:Raven_Charal.png|thumb|Terak and Charal]]
The castaway [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]] had the ability to turn into a raven, thanks to a Talisman of the Raven she had stolen on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Dathomir.<ref name="BoSSotDS" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], she failed her liege, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]], for the last time, so he seized her ring after she had changed to her raven form.<ref name="TBFE" />

Terak placed Charal's ring on his necklace, and later in a [[Battle of Endor (Ewok–Sanyassan conflict)|battle]] it was struck by a rock from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick's]] [[Slingshot/Legends|slingshot]]. The ring's power overtook Terak, and burned him to a crisp. The ring was destroyed as well, and Charal would remain a bird forever.<ref name="TBFE" />

==The raven in culture==
The Nightsisters of Dathomir were able to craft [[Talisman of Transformation|arcane artifacts]] known as [[Talisman of the Raven|Talismans of the Raven]], which allowed their wearer to [[Metamorphosis|assume the shape]] of a raven.<ref name="BoSSotDS" /> The name of this avian also made its way in the everyday language. Individuals such as [[Taselda]]<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> or [[Irek Ismaren]],<ref name="CoTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> whose [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was very black and lustrous, were sometimes called "raven-haired", by analogy with the bird's black iridescent plumage.

===Uses of raven in names===
*[[Ravenscreecher]], an avian of [[Wxtm]].
*[[Kyle Katarn]]'s fast light courier ship was named ''[[Raven's Claw]]''.
*[[Deathraven]], a mash-up of a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].
*[[Raven Squadron]], a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].
*[[Raven Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
*[[Raventhorn plant|Raven-thorn]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] of Yavin 4.
*[[Jai Raventhorn]], a woman.
*[[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]], Jai's sister.

==Behind the scenes==
The end credits of the [[1985]] made-for-TV film ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'' identifies Charal's bird form as being performed by a raven.
